<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin=par75 />{{GHGmargin-letter|75|k}}
'''5.''' Finally, a strongly-marked peculiarity of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} is the rejection of the ending {{GHGheb|text=־ֶה}} in forming the {{GHGterm|jussive}} and the {{GHGterm|imperfect consecutive}}. This shortening c curs in all the conjugations, and sometimes also involves further changes in the vocalization (see o, y, bb, gg). Similarly, in some conjugations a ''shortened imperative'' (cf. {{GHGpar|48|k}}) is formed by ''apocope'' of the final {{GHGheb|text=־ֵה}} (see cc, gg).

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|l}}
'''6.''' The ordinary form of the {{GHGterm|imperfect}} with the ending {{GHGheb|text=־ֶה}} serves in verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} to express the cohortative also ({{GHGpar|48|c}}); cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=1|verse=26}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=2|verse=18|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=25|verse=17}}, &c. With a final {{GHGheb|text=־ָה}} there occur only: in {{GHGterm|Qal}}, {{GHGheb|text=אֶשְׁעָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=119|verse=117}}, {{GHGheb|text=אֶֽהֱמָ֑יָה}} (with the {{GHGheb|text=י}} retained, see below, u) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=77|verse=4}}; and in {{GHGterm|Hithpaʿēl}} {{GHGheb|text=וְנִשְׁתָּ֫עָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=41|verse=23}} (with {{GHGterm|Ṭiphḥa}}, therefore in lesser pause).

{{center|{{Small-caps|Remarks.}}

I. ''On Qal .''}}

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|m}}
1. The older form of the {{GHGterm|fem.}} of the 3rd ''sing. perf.'' {{GHGheb|text=גָּלָת}}, mentioned above, under i (cf. {{GHGpar|74|g}}), is preserved in {{GHGheb|text=עָשָׂת}} (before {{GHGheb|text=א}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=21}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=9|verse=37}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}})<ref>In the Siloam inscription also (see above, {{GHGpar|2|d}}), line 3, {{GHGheb|text=הית}} may be read {{GHGheb|text=הָיָת}} quite as well as [{{GHGheb|text=ה}}]{{GHGheb|text=הָֽיְתָ}}.</ref>; likewise in {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הִרְצָת}} (before {{GHGheb|text=א}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=26|verse=34}}; {{GHGheb|text=הֶלְאָ֑ת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=24|verse=12}}; and in {{GHGterm|Hophʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=הָגְלָת}} (before {{GHGheb|text=יְ}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=13|verse=19}}.—The 2nd ''sing. fem.'' is also written {{GHGheb|text=־ִיתְ}}; thus in the textus receptus {{GHGheb|text=וְהָיִיתְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=14|verse=2}}, and always in Baer’s editions (since 1872), as in most other verbs; {{GHGheb|text=חָזִיתְ}} and {{GHGheb|text=גִּלִּיתְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=57|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=עָשִׂיתְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=2|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=16|verse=48}}, &c. (so {{GHGheb|text=וְהוֹצֵאתְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=17|verse=13}} from {{GHGheb|text=יָצָא}}). In the 3rd ''pers. plur.'' the tone, instead of keeping its usual place ({{GHGheb|text=גָּלוּ֫}}, &c.), is retracted in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=37|verse=20}}, {{GHGheb|text=כָּ֫לוּ}}, both on account of the {{GHGterm|pause}} and also in rhythmical antithesis to the preceding {{GHGheb|text=כָּלוּ֫}}; also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=16|verse=8}} {{GHGheb|text=תָּעוּ}} (according to Delitzsch for the sake of the assonance with {{GHGheb|text=נָגָ֫עוּ}}); and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=24|verse=1}} {{GHGheb|text=חָ֫זוּ}}.—On the tone of the {{GHGterm|perfect consecutive}} see {{GHGpar|49|k}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|n}}
2. The ''infin. absol.'' frequently has {{GHGheb|text=וֹ}} (probably a survival of the older orthography) for {{GHGheb|text=־ֹה}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=הָיוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=18|verse=18}}; {{GHGheb|text=עָשׂוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=4|verse=18}}, &c., {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=31|verse=11}}; {{GHGheb|text=קָנוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=24|verse=24}}; {{GHGheb|text=רָאוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=26|verse=28}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=6|verse=9}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=6|verse=12}}), &c., beside {{GHGheb|text=רָאֹה}}. The form {{GHGheb|text=שָׁתוֹת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=22|verse=13}} (beside {{GHGheb|text=שָׁתוֹ}} in the same verse) appears to have been chosen on account of its similarity in sound to {{GHGheb|text=שָׁחֹט}}; so in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=42|verse=20}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} and {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=10|verse=4}}, {{GHGheb|text=אָלוֹת}} (unless it is a substantive, ''oaths'') and {{GHGheb|text=כָּדֹת}}; cf. also {{GHGheb|text=עָרוֹת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Hb|chapter=3|verse=13}}.—Conversely, instead of the {{GHGterm|infinitive construct}} {{GHGheb|text=גְּלוֹת}} such forms are occasionally found as {{GHGheb|text=גְּלֹה}} or {{GHGheb|text=גְּלוֹ}}, cf. {{GHGheb|text=רְאֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=48|verse=11}}; {{GHGheb|text=קְנֹה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=16|verse=16}}; {{GHGheb|text=עֲשׂה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=50|verse=20}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=101|verse=3}}, also {{GHGheb|text=עֲשׂוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=28}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=31|verse=4}}), and even with the ''suffix'' {{GHGheb|text=הוּ}} the very remarkable form {{GHGheb|text=עֲשׂ֫הוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=18|verse=18}}.<ref>All these infinitives construct in ''ô'', in the Pentateuch, belong to the document called E; cf. {{GHGpar|69|m}}, second note.</ref>—The feminine form {{GHGheb|text=רַֽאֲוָה}} (for {{GHGheb|text=דְאוֹת}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=28|verse=17}}, analogous to nouns like {{GHGheb|text=גַּֽאֲוָה}} (cf. {{GHGpar|45|d}}), is strange, but {{GHGheb|text=הֱיֵה}} as ''infin.'' {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=21|verse=15}} is quite inexplicable.—The forms {{GHGheb|text=הֹגוֹ}} and {{GHGheb|text=הֹרוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=59|verse=13}} are perhaps to be regarded with Barth, {{GHGcite|title=Nominalbildung}}, {{GHGpar|51|a}}, as ''infinitives absolute'' of the {{GHGterm|passive}} of {{GHGterm|Qal}} (see above, {{GHGpar|53|u}}), not of {{GHGterm|Pôʿēl}}.—The 2nd ''sing. masc. imperative'' {{GHGheb|text=וֶחְֽיֶה}} occurs in the principal pause in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=4|verse=4}} and {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=7|verse=2|hidebook=1}};
